dish.title: French Onion Soup with Gruyere Toasts and Butter Lettuce Salad

recipe_version.title: French Onion Soup with Gruyere Toasts and Butter Lettuce Salad
recipe_version.description: Three pounds of onions slowly caramelized in butter until deep mahogany, simmered with beef stock, thyme, and a splash of sherry vinegar, then crowned with a toasted baguette slice and bubbling, browned Gruyere under the broiler. A simple Dijon-dressed butter lettuce salad on the side.

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Halve and thinly slice the onions. Slice the baguette, grate the Gruyere, and tear the lettuce. Whisk the Dijon, red wine vinegar, olive oil, and a pinch of salt in the salad bowl.

steps.title: Caramelize the onions
steps.body: Melt the butter in the Dutch oven over medium. Add the onions and 1 tsp salt and cook, stirring every few minutes and lowering to medium-low once they start to color, until deep brown and jammy, 50 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer the soup
steps.body: Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then add the stock, thyme, and bay leaves. Simmer 20 minutes. Discard the thyme stems and bay, and stir in the sherry vinegar and pepper.

steps.title: Preheat the broiler
steps.body: While the soup simmers, preheat the broiler to high with a rack 6 inches below it (overlap stated).

steps.title: Toast the bread
steps.body: Lay the baguette slices on the baking sheet and broil until golden on both sides, 1 1/2 minutes per side.

steps.title: Gratinee
steps.body: Set the crocks on the baking sheet, ladle in the soup, top each with 2 toasts and the Gruyere, and broil until bubbling and browned in spots, 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Dress the salad and serve
steps.body: While the cheese broils, toss the lettuce with the dressing (overlap stated). Let the crocks stand 2 minutes and serve with the salad.
